description: Telangana State government to implement AI-based FLN project in all districts after successful pilot in select areas.
body_lead: The Telangana State government, after using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to teach Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) in government schools as a pilot project in six select districts, will implement it across the State in all the districts from Saturday (March 15). The project is being taken up by the State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT) in collaboration with Bengaluru-based EkStep Foundation. The decision was taken after the six districts — Bhadradi Kothagudem, Khammam, Medak, Medchal-Malkajgiri, Narayanpet, and Vikarabad — showed improving results.
